{{Quote|I hope they find all of them, fast, and then we can get back to normal business.|Unidentified Rodian pilot on the Jedi|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Rodian pilot''' was once stuck on the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|Mezeg sector]] freight terminal during an inspection by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on all departing [[Starship/Legends|ships]] for stowaways. While waiting, he struck up a conversation with fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]], who was trying to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] off the terminal and onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] complained to Vollen how the inspection was ruining his schedule, as well as his dislike for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Jedi. I never trusted them anyway. My buddy&mdash;he lost his ship once, no compensation, nothing, when one of their fancy Masters commandeered it for some getaway. No please, thank you, or here’s some creds to tide you over, friend. Just took it. Higher authority. Mystic and righteous work. Piracy, more like&mdash;government-backed thieves. Well, they got theirs. Good riddance.|Unidentified Rodian pilot|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />}}
The Rodian pilot had a deep hatred for the Jedi, borne from the fact that a friend of his was not properly compensated by the Jedi after his ship was forcefully taken by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during an urgent escape. When asked whether he'd turn one in after they were outlawed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he remarked that he'd do so even without receiving the promised reward.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
